recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is needed for FHIR-3533 unless MnM reopens the ContactPoint naming or preferred-contact model in a future decision.
issue_request: FHIR-3533 was a Published FHIR-core datatypes change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, after Patient Administration proposed renaming the Contact datatype because it conflicted with resource contact components and also asked about a preferred contact flag. The final recorded resolution was to rename the Contact data type to ContactPoint.
initial_application: The rename was applied by historical git commit 05f794cd7a297f22268684c1f9191ab7d1df51f1, whose subject is "Change Contact to ContactPoint" and whose git-svn-id points to trunk/build@2919, matching the Jira comment that SVN revision 2919 applied the issue. The commit renamed source/datatypes/contact.xml to source/datatypes/contactpoint.xml and updated datatype pages, examples, mappings, diagrams, and source/fhir.ini references.
additional_context: ContactPoint is now listed as an active datatype in source/fhir.ini and marked normative. Current source/datatypes/contactpoint.xml and the datatype page inputs expose ContactPoint, not a standalone Contact datatype. The preferred-flag part of the original description was not in FHIR-3533's final resolution; later related decisions FHIR-7625 and FHIR-7626 rejected a redundant preferred=true/false flag and added ContactPoint.rank, with the FHIR-7626 audit already present on the combined branch. Later FHIR-16984 and FHIR-38824 only clarified rank semantics.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already reflects the approved ContactPoint rename and the current rank mechanism covers preference ordering without adding a boolean preferred flag.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change issue rejected adding a preferred=true/false ContactPoint flag because rank was being added.
Later Published issue added ContactPoint.rank for preference ordering; it is already represented on the combined branch by ced4ab500919bbc63ab62fd9734aca1962b5db9c.
Clarified that ContactPoints with lower rank values are more preferred than those with higher values.
Clarified that ContactPoint ranks need not be unique or sequential and may be omitted.
